## Context
Implement the attack demo panel to visualize scripted security attack scenarios and the system's detection and mitigation responses.

## Requirements
- Scripted attack scenarios: replay, counter regression, session hijack attempt, MITM
- Real-time visualization of detection and kill response
- Show explainable decisions (reason codes, point deductions)
- Demonstrate mid-session kill on risk spike

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Attack scenarios visualized in UI
- [ ] Detection and response displayed in real-time
- [ ] Explainable decisions shown (reason codes + point deductions)
- [ ] Mid-session kill triggered and visualized
